title: Beyond Single Bugs: Benchmarking Large Language Models for Multi-Vulnerability Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the tendency of LLMs to under-report the total number of vulnerabilities in long-context code files by injecting controlled counts of vulnerabilities (1, 3, 5, and 9) and evaluating the model's predictions using Mean Absolute Error (MAE) and ExactFile accuracy.

Evaluating the model's performance on multi-label vulnerability extraction tasks to determine if it favors finding specific, frequent, or obvious vulnerabilities while ignoring others, measured by the degradation of Recall as vulnerability density increases.
